business_scope.primary_industry_name: Production and Global Distribution of Vertical Micro-Dramas

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Marshall Islands (unitary national jurisdiction; no sub-state tax or corporate law distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (Unitary_National): U.S.-influenced common law constitutional framework incorporating entrenched customary law; Business Corporations Act 1990 modeled on the Delaware General Corporation Law
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: United States - Republic of the Marshall Islands Compact of Free Association (1986, amended 2003): principal investment-protection and economic-relations treaty in force
Pacific Island Countries Trade Agreement (PICTA) and Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER): regional trade frameworks with RMI membership
No dedicated bilateral investment treaty or double-taxation agreement in force for RMI as of the date of this dossier

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Business Corporations Act 1990 (Title 10, RMI Revised Code 2006, as amended), esp. ss. 10-16 (formation, corporate names) and s. 47 (registered agent custody of share ledger); Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2012, as amended (AML/CFT Act); Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) Departmental Directives on Customer Due Diligence and Beneficial Ownership; Counter-Terrorism and Transnational Organized Crime Act 2015; RMI National Money Laundering/Terrorist Financing Risk Assessment; RMI obligations as member of the Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering (APG).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, Majuro
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (RMI competent authority) or consular legalization for non-Hague jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified True Copy of the Bylaws
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization by RMI notary public followed by Hague Apostille

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (Certificate of Existence)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Registered Agent's Consent to Act in the Republic of the Marshall Islands

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based CDD per AML/CFT Act 2012: all directors, shareholders, beneficial owners, authorized signatories, and counterparties (including Apple IAP, Google Play Billing, and Stripe payment rails) must be screened before incorporation against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, RMI targeted financial sanctions list, OFAC SDN list, EU Consolidated Sanctions list, and Interpol notices. PEP status of any shareholder, director, or UBO triggers enhanced due diligence, senior-management approval, and ongoing transaction monitoring. Screening evidence and CDD records must be retained for at least five (5) years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Marshall Islands Registrar of Corporations (Office of the Attorney General); all submissions and name reservations are effected through licensed registered agents utilizing the Registrar's electronic filing system
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: English is the sole statutory corporate language; corporate names must use the Latin alphabet; no Marshallese transliteration obligation exists; the name must clearly distinguish the entity from all names on the RMI and foreign-qualified registries and may not indicate an unstated corporate purpose
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: any token implying Crown, state, or ministerial patronage absent written consent
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The registered agent files a name reservation; the Registrar typically responds within five to seven business days. Upon rejection (usually for confusing similarity or a prohibited token), counsel may request written reasons within 14 days, file an amended reservation, or submit a formal administrative appeal to the Registrar within 30 days of the refusal. A rejected applicant remains entitled to a refund of the reservation fee only if the rejection was a Registrar error. Final recourse lies in judicial review by the High Court of the Marshall Islands under the Civil Procedure Rules, with a customary 30-day filing window from the administrative decision.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Fully permissible. A non-resident Business Corporation must maintain only a registered office address (normally the business address of the licensed registered agent) and a registered agent in the Marshall Islands. No local employees, physical premises, or substantive local operations are mandated for a low-risk non-resident digital media distribution entity; the registered agent itself must maintain a verifiable physical presence.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Very Low (estimated below 10% for an incorporated non-resident entity with no local asset footprint). The Registrar conducts no routine unannounced physical inspections under the BCA; inspection probability rises meaningfully only upon a specific regulatory trigger such as a consumer complaint, sanctions allegation, FIU inquiry, or judicial order.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act, Republic of the Marshall Islands Revised Code, Title 15, Chapter 3, Sections 3-101 et seq. (incorporation, registered agent, organizational action, and officer appointment provisions)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Attorney General, Registrar of Corporations, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (Business Corporation); Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow account requirement; the Articles must state authorized shares (e.g., 5,000 shares of no par value) and shares may be issued for any lawful consideration fixed by the Board
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Corporation approves the subscription for 5,000 shares of no par value common stock by the initial subscribers named in the Articles of Incorporation, and directs the officers to issue the subscribed shares upon receipt of lawful consideration therefor; RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Corporation within the Republic of the Marshall Islands shall be located at the address of its licensed registered agent in Majuro, and the registered agent appointed in the Articles of Incorporation is hereby ratified and continued in office; RESOLVED, that the following persons are appointed as officers of the Corporation until the next annual meeting of the Board: Chief Executive Officer, Chief Financial Officer, and Corporate Secretary, each with customary authority to execute banking documents, payment-rail agreements, and distribution contracts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, Majuro
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request by email or in person to the Registrar listing at least two proposed corporate names; the Registrar checks for deceptive similarity against the corporate index and reserves an available name for 30 days. Pay the name reservation fee by official receipt.
required_dossiers: Incorporate officer or incorporator identification document
Proof of name reservation fee payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity, submit additional alternative names or file a written request for administrative reconsideration with the Registrar within 14 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of Resident Registered Agent and Registered Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Marshall Islands registered agent (law firm, trust company, or service provider) operating in Majuro
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a registered agent licensed under the Business Corporations Act to maintain a physical office in the Marshall Islands; execute the agent consent form designating the agent for service of process. Obtain a certified copy of the agent's license for attachment to the Articles.
required_dossiers: Registered agent consent and acceptance letter
Certified copy of registered agent license
Physical office address confirmation in Majuro
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent is disqualified or refused, replace the agent and file a statement of change of registered agent with the Registrar before filing the Articles.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Marshall Islands notary public (or consular officer for foreign-based incorporators)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation stating the corporate name, purpose (all lawful business, including production and global digital distribution of vertical micro-dramas), authorized shares, registered office and agent, and incorporator details. The incorporator must sign the Articles in the presence of a notary public who verifies identity and affixes the official seal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notarization is defective or the signatory appears on a disqualification list, obtain re-execution and re-notarization of a corrected document; no re-filing fee is assessed if corrected before lodgement.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Lodgement of Articles and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, Majuro
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the notarized Articles together with the statutory filing fee via official bank draft payable to the RMI Government, and the registered agent's consent. The Registrar reviews the document for legal completeness, assigns a registration number, and issues the Certificate of Incorporation with the corporate seal.
required_dossiers: Filing fee bank draft or official receipt (USD)
Cover letter stating requested effective date
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a query or request for clarification, respond in writing within 30 days with corrected Articles or supplementary affidavits; failure to cure results in withdrawal, and the applicant may resubmit with a new fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adoption of Bylaws and First Organizational Action of the Board
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the Corporation (private organizational action)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within the first calendar month after incorporation, the initial directors adopt the corporate bylaws and the First Board Resolution by unanimous written consent, covering share subscription and issuance, ratification of the registered office/agent, and appointment of officers. Record the minutes and file internally with the corporate records book.
required_dossiers: Share subscription list and issuance ledger
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a director's signature is missing or a quorum is not established, adjourn and reconvene the organizational meeting or obtain a new unanimous written consent; no public filing is required for this cure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Compliance: Annual Report, Tax-Exempt Confirmation, and General Business Licensing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations and Ministry of Finance (Treasury), Majuro
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the initial annual report and pay the annual government fee to maintain good standing. Obtain written confirmation of non-resident tax-exempt status under the RMI Income Tax Act and confirm that no statutory film/content license applies to virtual micro-drama production and streaming distribution for non-resident customers. If a physical office is established, obtain a general business license from the Ministry of Finance.
required_dossiers: Business license application (if office premises are used)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the annual report is rejected for arrears or missing data, pay the penalty and file an amended report; if administratively dissolved, apply for reinstatement within 24 months with payment of all outstanding fees.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Commerce and Trade, Business Facilitation Division; no film censorship board or specific industrial license is mandated for digital vertical micro-drama production and distribution in the Marshall Islands
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: General Business License (optional, required only if a physical production office or studio is established in the Marshall Islands)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI EPA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - low-impact commercial/office activity and virtual production do not trigger a full EIA Report or EIA Registration; no construction, land disturbance, or effluent discharge is associated with vertical micro-drama content production and streaming distribution
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater, VOC, or hazardous waste discharge anticipated; if backup generators are installed at the production office, comply with RMI EPA air emission limits for diesel generators and maintain a fuel spill containment plan; solid-waste segregation and collection per local municipal standards apply

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification for office/studio premises in Majuro, including serviced fire extinguishers and adequate egress signage under the RMI Fire Code; structural load inspection is required only if heavy lighting rigs or server racks are installed; occupational workplace clearance under the Division of Labor, Ministry of Finance covers a safe electrical setup and ergonomic workstation compliance

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Revenue and Taxation Authority (RTA), Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands; corporate and beneficial-ownership registry: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General (Majuro). Filing is predominantly paper-based; no public e-filing portal exists. The Registrar of Corporations is operationally supported by International Registries, Inc. (IRI) under a long-term administrative services agreement.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A non-resident Business Corporation (BC) formed under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act (BCA) is not required to register with the RTA merely to hold foreign-source revenue. SOP: (1) file Articles of Incorporation with the Registrar of Corporations and obtain a Certificate of Incorporation (no minimum capital); (2) appoint a Registered Agent in Majuro and file a Beneficial Ownership Registration; (3) if no RMI-source revenue is derived, no income tax or Business Gross Revenue Tax (BGRT) registration arises; (4) optionally, a General Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) may be obtained from the RTA by submitting the Certificate of Incorporation, Registered Agent confirmation, and a non-resident business declaration; (5) no VAT ID exists because the RMI does not operate a VAT system. The BC's only recurring obligation is the annual corporate report and franchise fee paid to the Registrar.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone (territorial sourcing): a non-resident BC deriving exclusively foreign-source income from the production and global distribution of vertical micro-dramas is exempt from RMI income tax, BGRT, withholding taxes, and capital-based taxes. No permanent-establishment threshold applies, but the exemption lapses if the BC derives income from sources inside the Marshall Islands or carries on business within the RMI (e.g., local screenings, local advertisers, or physical production in Majuro).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box, hybrid-mismatch, or participation-exemption election exists under RMI law. Tax-exempt status arises by operation of law for non-resident BCs. The BCA permits a formal election to designate the entity as a 'non-resident domestic corporation' for governance and registry purposes. Separately, for U.S. federal tax classification, an RMI Business Corporation is generally treated as a per se corporation under U.S. Treasury Regulations and therefore is not eligible for U.S. check-the-box classification; that is a U.S. tax matter, not an RMI statutory election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT, GST, or general sales/use tax in the Marshall Islands. Indirect taxation is limited to (a) import duty on physical goods under RMI customs law and (b) Business Gross Revenue Tax (BGRT) of 3% on the gross revenue of any person carrying on business within the RMI. Digital app-store sales of micro-drama content to overseas end users are outside the scope of both taxes. The BC should nevertheless note that Apple, Google, and Stripe may collect foreign digital-services VAT/GST (e.g., EU, Australia, Singapore, Korea) on behalf of the seller in customer jurisdictions; those foreign taxes are not RMI taxes.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No VAT threshold exists because no VAT regime operates. For BGRT, registration is required from the first dollar of RMI-source gross revenue for any person carrying on business within the RMI; a non-resident BC with no RMI activity has no nexus and no registration threshold. An importer code is required only if physical goods are imported into the RMI, which is not the case for pure digital distribution.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. The RMI has no e-invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, continuous transaction control (CTC), API-based tax reporting, or digital stamping mandate. Invoicing and records follow general commercial standards; no government data-exchange format is required.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable: the RMI operates no VAT/GST regime, and therefore no zero-rating, export-refund, or input-credit mechanism exists. The non-resident BC's revenues from the global distribution of vertical micro-dramas through Apple IAP, Google Play Billing, and Stripe are foreign-source and constitutionally outside the RMI indirect tax net; no claim, election, or refund procedure is required, and no RMI output tax is charged to end users.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Not applicable for digital exports: no Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading, or Inward Remittance Certificate is required for streaming-based micro-drama distribution because no physical goods cross the RMI border. If the BC were to export physical media (e.g., promotional merchandise or pre-loaded sd cards), the RMI Customs Division would require a Customs Export Declaration and transport document; however, no export VAT certificate exists in the RMI.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No export zero-rating fraud regime exists because no zero-rating mechanism exists. General enforcement: the RTA may reassess income tax and BGRT (3%) plus statutory interest on any revenue proven to be sourced in the RMI, such as local theatrical screenings, Majuro-based advertisers, physical production conducted in the RMI, or management functions performed from the RMI. The Income Tax Act provides civil penalties and administrative fines for failure to file or for false returns when RMI-source income is at issue, and the RMI business license regime imposes separate penalties for operating locally without a license. The RMI has no currency controls or FX repatriation deadline, hence the 0-day figure; however, the RMI is a member of the OECD BEPS Inclusive Framework and exchanges beneficial-ownership and CRS information. The BC should contemporaneously retain app-store payout reports (Apple App Store Connect, Google Play Console), Stripe settlement statements, bank records, management accounts, and subscriber geolocation data to substantiate the absence of RMI-source revenue in the event of an RTA information request or challenge.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: No domestic central bank exists in the Republic of the Marshall Islands; the official legal tender is the United States dollar. Monetary supervision is performed indirectly by the U.S. Federal Reserve System, with prudential regulation and licensing of domestic depository institutions carried out by the Marshall Islands Banking Commissioner under the Banking Act of 1991 and the Financial Institutions Act.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Marshall Islands operates a fully dollarized monetary system, meaning there is no distinction between local currency and hard reserve currency. Both current and capital account transactions are freely convertible and unrestricted. No exchange control legislation, no central bank licensing of foreign exchange transactions, and no restriction on profit repatriation, dividends, or capital returns exist for non-resident Business Corporations. The only formal hurdles relate to Corporate Registry filing fees, annual license franchise tax, and anti-money laundering recordkeeping obligations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There are absolutely no statutory export proceeds surrender rules, no mandatory repatriation timelines, and no minimum conversion ratios. A Marshall Islands Business Corporation may retain export receipts in any jurisdiction, in any currency, and utilize such funds without central bank approval. This position is confirmed by the absence of exchange control regulations under the Marshall Islands Revised Code and the Currency and Valuation Act practice.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Guam – Marshall Islands Branch
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD Account / Commercial Settlement Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low as the primary treasury clearing venue; Medium as a supplementary collection and payout channel. The Marshall Islands has no digital bank, electronic money institution, or fintech licensing regime; therefore local EMIs cannot be formed or regulated. Offshore digital EMIs may be engaged as payment aggregators or custodial wallet providers for micro-drama app store receipts, but they do not provide secure wire transfer rails, cannot issue bank guarantees, and often lack access to USD correspondent banking. Legal constraints also include US OFAC sanctions screening expectations, FATF membership expectations, and the inability of EMIs to provide corporate credit products.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence at the bank is generally mandated for the ultimate beneficial owner or at least one director during initial account opening at both Bank of Marshall Islands and Bank of Guam. No branchless or fully remote opening is permitted for non-resident Business Corporations. Where physical travel is impractical, some banks accept a video interview supplemented by a bank-confirmed introducer, embassy notarization, or professional intermediary signature guarantee, but the prevailing statutory rule requires an in-person KYC interview for the natural person controlling the entity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity, high-volume small remittances from Apple IAP and Google Play Billing into a newly opened offshore treasury account.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide app store merchant payout statements for the prior six months, platform distribution agreements, standard digital content license agreements, user revenue reconciliation reports, the ISIC 5911 business scope certificate, and a transaction monitoring procedure demonstrating screening against sanctions, PEP lists, and source-of-funds continuity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident shell-like structure with no local employees, no physical office, and all operations performed through overseas service providers.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver the Marshall Islands Certificate of Incorporation, certificate of good standing, registered agent service agreement, registered office address lease or service license, minutes of board resolutions approving the banking relationship, shareholder register with UBO declaration, and a substance memorandum demonstrating effective management from the registered office and distribution contracts with content platforms.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border trade disbursements to independent production studios in high-risk jurisdictions for micro-drama shooting and post-production services.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Prepare robust commercial contracts for each production, itemised invoices matching per-episode cost structures, crew and cast payroll reports, actual production schedules, technical post-production deliverables, and a legally binding compliance representation that each counterparty passes sanctions screening and is not linked to terrorism financing or forced labor.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound capital injection from related companies or offshore financing entities outside the United States into the Marshall Islands Business Corporation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit intercompany loan agreements, shareholder capital contribution resolutions, UBO identification documents with banking references for all beneficial owners, source of wealth certification supported by tax records or audited financials, a compliant transfer pricing policy, and confirmation that the funds are solely for production working capital and platform launch expenses.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: For compliant inbound capital injection, the standard routing is a SWIFT MT103 wire denominated in USD through the shareholder's banking institution to the Bank of Marshall Islands or Bank of Guam correspondent account in the United States, using advice purpose code (e.g., 'INVT' or 'LOAN' as applicable under ISO 20022), with the beneficiary account being a USD treasury account owned by the Marshall Islands Business Corporation. The sending bank must include the corporate legal name and ultimate beneficiary owner reference. Since the Marshall Islands has no foreign exchange controls, a foreign investment registration certificate is not required; however, the domestic bank will request an internal memorandum mapping the wire to a board-approved capital plan, a signed source-of-funds declaration, and a valid certificate of good standing to satisfy internal OFAC and AML verification.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements for production services, post-production, royalty splits, and marketing agency fees will be executed over the SWIFT network, predominantly MT103 customer credit transfers and, for interbank liquidity settlement, MT202 COV messages. Where the arrangement requires documentary credit, a Commercial Letter of Credit (MT700/MT710) may be issued through the domestic bank with a confirming bank based in the U.S. or Hong Kong. Ultimate clearing of all USD payments will occur through the U.S. Federal Reserve Bank wire network or CHIPS, using the domestic bank's U.S. correspondent relationship. No separate domestic clearing house exists in the Marshall Islands, so all treasury settlements are effectively cleared and settled in the U.S. banking system.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Vanilla foreign exchange forwards for major currencies up to 12 months tenor against USD
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in restricted Asian currencies, including Filipino peso and Indonesian rupiah settlement equivalents
Cross-currency swaps for substantial app store revenue streams denominated in EUR, JPY, KRW, and CNY
FX options and collar structures for managing royalty and production cost volatility
Readily marketable standby FX line or multi-currency sweep accounts to offset minor collection currency mismatches without a derivatives contract

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report and Annual Franchise Tax Filing (Annual Government Renewal Fee)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (administered through a licensed registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after each incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of US$50 per month or part thereof, subject to a maximum of US$200; continued non-filing for two consecutive years may trigger administrative dissolution or strike-off by the Registrar.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory independent audit for a non-resident, privately held Marshall Islands business corporation. A mandatory audit applies only to listed companies, licensed banks, insurance companies, and other regulated financial institutions.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No mandatory local GAAP; a non-resident business corporation may consistently apply IFRS or US GAAP.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The Marshall Islands has no public UBO register. The licensed registered agent must maintain current beneficial ownership records and must be notified within 30 days of any share transfer or ownership change; an annual UBO re-confirmation is conducted by the registered agent as part of the annual KYC/CDD refresh, but no separate UBO filing is made to the Registrar.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not mandatory; voluntary certified audit typically US$2,500–US$6,000 per annum

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — no corporate income tax is imposed by the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI); Non-Resident Domestic Corporations (NRDCs) under the Business Corporations Act are statutorily exempt.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full exemption under the Non-Resident Domestic Corporation Act 2001 (as amended): 0% CIT, 0% branch profit tax, 0% dividend/interest/royalty withholding tax, 0% capital gains tax, 0% gross revenue tax on foreign-source revenue; only fixed annual government fees apply (incorporation fee approximately USD 300–500, annual report fee approximately USD 200).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: None — an RMI NRDC is not required to file any corporate income tax return. The only mandatory compliance filing is the Annual Report with the RMI Registrar of Corporations (online portal administered through the licensed registered agent).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 30 days after the anniversary of the date of incorporation; agents typically align this with the company's fiscal year-end calendar.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the exact Business Corporations Act certificate number issued at incorporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office in the Republic of the Marshall Islands
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be a physical address in Majuro provided by the licensed registered agent; post-office box alone is not sufficient.
A licensed RMI registered agent is mandatory; the agent must countersign the report.
List all directors; non-resident individuals or legal entities are permitted; no local residency requirement.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Issued share capital and shareholder details
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum capital required; bearer shares are prohibited; beneficial ownership information must be maintained and updated.
Standard annual fee USD 200 plus USD 15 per each additional USD 10,000 of authorised capital above the first USD 50,000, as applied by the registered agent's schedule.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of USD 500 is assessed automatically; delinquency for six months may result in administrative dissolution by the Registrar, requiring reinstatement fees and court or Registrar orders; the registered agent may resign, triggering strike-off.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: RMI Gross Revenue Tax Return (form GRT-1) — filed with the Revenue and Taxation Office, Majuro, only if the NRDC carries on a taxable business within the Republic; ordinary non-resident foreign-source activities are outside scope.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 30 days after the close of each calendar quarter (30 April, 31 July, 31 October, 31 January); a nil return is required for any quarter during which an RMI business permit is active.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue derived from sources within the Republic
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report zero if no RMI-source revenue; export sales of digital content to non-RMI users are outside the RMI gross revenue tax base.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exempt revenue (export sales and income exempted under the Non-Resident Domestic Corporation Act)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach a schedule demonstrating that all revenue is foreign-source and therefore exempt.
2% on wholesale and import trade; 3% on services and retail trade within RMI; do not apply if Line 2 equals Line 1.
Multiply taxable gross revenue by the applicable rate; no deductions or credits are available.
Late payment penalty is 10% of the tax due; interest accrues at 1.5% per month or fraction thereof.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to register is a misdemeanour carrying a fine of up to USD 5,000; late filing penalty is 10% of the tax due; late payment interest accrues monthly; continued non-compliance results in cancellation of the RMI business licence and referral to the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — RMI imposes no dividend withholding tax on distributions by a Business Corporation to non-resident shareholders, whether in cash or in kind.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: RMI maintains no double tax avoidance treaty network; no treaty clearance or Tax Residence Certificate is required because the exemption is automatic at source. For bank and auditor due diligence, a request letter for a Certificate of Tax Status may be submitted to the RMI Revenue and Taxation Office together with the certificate of incorporation and a board resolution confirming non-resident exempt status; processing typically takes 10–15 business days. RMI does not issue IRS Form W-8 or any equivalent certificate.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate: 0% on both interest and royalty payments made by an RMI NRDC to non-residents. Treaty rate: not applicable (no DTA network). Caution: underlying end-market taxes, such as US FATCA backup withholding or foreign withholding on app-store proceeds, are governed by the source jurisdiction and are not relieved by RMI law.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory transfer-pricing threshold in the Republic of the Marshall Islands; RMI has no enacted transfer-pricing law. As a best-practice safeguard, prepare USD-denominated intercompany agreements and a Local File when annual intercompany transactions exceed USD 2,000,000, though no filing is statutorily mandated.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Economic Substance (Amendment) Act 2021 and the Economic Substance Regulations 2021 require an RMI registered entity carrying on relevant activities to demonstrate adequate economic presence in RMI. Vertical micro-drama production and distribution may be classified as IP-holding, distribution, or service-centre activity; the company must document RMI board meetings, local agent oversight, bank accounts, and payroll or expenditure proportional to value creation. A purely non-resident exempt entity with no relevant activity files an annual ESR notification or nil declaration through the Registrar's electronic portal. Non-compliance penalties: initial fine up to USD 10,000, continuing daily default fine of USD 100, and automatic exchange of information with foreign tax authorities.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate omission of end-user subscription revenue from group records in the false belief that an RMI exemption protects all offshore income, or fabrication of fake production expenses such as inflated talent contracts and user-acquisition invoices to shift profit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil fraud penalty of 25% of the understated gross revenue tax, if RMI-source, plus 1.5% monthly interest; criminal referral under the RMI Criminal Code for tax fraud carries a fine of up to USD 25,000 and imprisonment of up to 5 years per count.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false returns are jointly and severally liable for corporate penalties; RMI courts may pierce the corporate veil and order restitution of diverted funds; travel bans and surrender of passports may be imposed for flight risk; conviction results in disqualification from serving as a director for 5 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the MH BC as a bare nominee without RMI substance while directing IP ownership, licensing decisions, bank signatories, and distribution contracts from a non-resident management company; no bookkeeping, no meeting minutes, and no substance notification.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Violation of the Economic Substance Regulations 2021: fine of up to USD 10,000 per offence plus daily default fine of USD 100; the Registrar may strike off the company; foreign tax authorities may re-characterise the entire revenue stream as taxable in the end-market under GAAR or look-through rules, triggering full corporate income tax, interest, and penalties in the source country.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be personally assessed by foreign revenue authorities under controlled-foreign-company and economic-substance rules; RMI courts may award restitution for misrepresentation to the Registrar; foreign travel bans and extradition requests are enforceable under RMI law; disqualification from holding RMI fiduciary roles for up to 10 years may apply.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Channeling in-app purchase revenue through the MH BC bank account without beneficial-ownership verification of connected shareholders, allowing the app platform to process payments to sanctioned end-users, or offering anonymity to high-risk advertisers.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Breach of the RMI Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Act 2005 (as amended): civil penalty of up to USD 1,000,000 for the corporate entity and up to USD 250,000 per responsible individual; wilful breach is a criminal offence punishable by fine and imprisonment of up to 10 years; US OFAC secondary sanctions exposure may attach through dollar-clearing banking.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors sign the AML compliance statement and are presumed to have knowledge where books are absent; civil clawback of the value of payments processed in breach; criminal travel bans, asset freeze orders by the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit, and extradition to the end-market jurisdiction for money laundering where the predicate offence is proven.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using Apple IAP, Google Play Billing, and Stripe payment rails while commingling user balances, falsifying refund records, reprocessing disputed micro-transactions, or failing to disclose subscription auto-renewal terms in the vertical drama app.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The RMI Banking Act 1991 treats unlicensed payment intermediation as a criminal offence: fine of up to USD 100,000 and imprisonment of up to 7 years; the RMI Trade Commission may revoke the export licence, impose consumer restitution orders, and platform-level sanctions may include permanent de-listing from Apple and Google with withholding of receivable balances.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who direct the commingling of user funds face personal restitution orders, disqualification as officers of the Business Corporation, and civil fraud liability to aggrieved users; flight risk triggers RMI court-ordered travel bans and attachment of personal assets; extradition may follow under bilateral arrangements with the United States for wire-fraud predicates.
